title: parser_drift_list_response
description: Response body for GET /v1/audit/parser-drift (spec 012 S4). One row per (api_format, event_type) an LLM-proxy parser reported as unrecognised for the session's tenant, most recently seen first. `sample_redacted` is keys-only (`keys=a,b,c`), never payload content. `new_since_boot` is the number of rows first inserted since this gateway node booted (the same counter /readyz reports as `parser_drift`).

api_format.description: LlmProviderConfig.api_format the parser was selected for (e.g. anthropic_messages, openai_responses).

event_type.description: Discriminator the parser logged: `event:<type>`, `block:<type>`, `delta:<type>` (Anthropic) or `event:<type>`, `output_item:<type>` (OpenAI Responses).

sample_redacted.description: Keys-only sample of the first sighting (`keys=a,b,c`, at most 200 bytes).
